_readme: Level ranges for the 9 new dungeons come from Wowhead's 'Dungeons Overview for Forever' guide (wowhead.com/forever/guide/dungeons-overview-locations-details), matching that page's own structured Dungeon/Lower Level/Upper Level table. Note: Wowhead's page has an internal inconsistency for Krol'dok Stronghold -- its table says 40-45 but its prose paragraph says 'Level 40-55'; the reference level-range chart image this data was cross-checked against also shows 40-55 for Krol'dok (apparently sourced from that same prose line). Went with the table value (40-45) since it's Wowhead's own structured/authoritative figure and matches every other dungeon's table-vs-prose agreement -- Krol'dok and City of Dalaran (also table 28-33 vs prose '20-35', where the chart image agrees with the table) are the only two mismatches on Wowhead's page, both resolved in favor of the table. Descriptions below are paraphrased from that same guide's prose, not copied verbatim. Classic dungeon level ranges are transcribed from the provided reference_dungeons_list.png chart image -- except 'ubrs' (Upper Blackrock Spire), added later when building the dungeon loot feature after finding wowtbc.gg's loot-table source covers it separately from Lower Blackrock Spire while this file only had 'lbrs'; the chart image never included an Upper Blackrock Spire entry to transcribe from, so 58-60 here is the standard Classic-era level range, not from that same chart.

dungeons.name: Hall of Thanes
dungeons.description: Tucked under the city of Ironforge itself, this dungeon puts a Level 13-18 Alliance party against whatever has moved into the tunnels below the dwarven capital.

dungeons.name: Ruins of Lordaeron
dungeons.description: The fallen human capital is still standing -- in ruins -- and still occupied. A Level 15-20 Horde dungeon built around picking through what's left of Lordaeron and whatever still lurks in it.

dungeons.name: Excavation Site: Wetlands
dungeons.description: Built on top of Whelgar's Excavation Site in the Wetlands, this Level 24-29 dungeon turns an existing dig-site landmark into a full instance.

dungeons.name: City of Dalaran
dungeons.description: Dalaran's protective barrier has finally come down. The city itself has been restored, but it isn't fully secured yet, and the Kirin Tor need a Level 28-33 party's help retaking it.

dungeons.name: The Drowned City
dungeons.zone: Off the coast of Stranglethorn Vale
dungeons.description: An ancient, sunken troll ruin just off Stranglethorn Vale's coastline, for a Level 35-40 group. This was one of the dungeons actually playable on the BlizzCon 2026 show floor.

dungeons.name: Krol'dok Stronghold
dungeons.description: A Level 40-45 stronghold dungeon in Riverglades, the new zone built on unused terrain, east of Swamp of Sorrows, Redridge, and Burning Steppes

dungeons.name: Alcaz Prison
dungeons.zone: Alcaz Island, far northeast of Dustwallow Marsh
dungeons.description: A Level 48-53 dungeon on Alcaz Island, well northeast of Dustwallow Marsh's coastline.

dungeons.name: Blackmaw Hold
dungeons.zone: North Azshara, behind the Furbolg Gates
dungeons.description: A sprawling furbolg city behind North Azshara's Furbolg Gates, for a Level 55-60 group. Wowhead's own guide notes there isn't much confirmed detail on this one yet beyond its size and location.

dungeons.name: Shaper's Terrace
dungeons.description: A Level 58-60 dungeon set in Un'Goro Crater.
